steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Rate = Delta[conc]/Deltat; collision theory: effective collisions need E >= Ea and correct orientation

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Maxwell-Boltzmann: at higher T, more molecules exceed Ea -> exponentially more effective collisions

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Rate law: rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ; m,n = order (not necessarily stoichiometric); overall order = m+n

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 1st order: rate = k[A]; t½ = ln2/k (constant); ln[A] = -kt + ln[A]₀

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: For N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, DeltaH = -92 kJ/mol. Predict effect on yield of: (a) increasing pressure, (b) increasing temperature, (c) adding Fe catalyst --- Solution: (a) 4 mol gas -> 2 mol gas: shift right -> higher yield. (b) Exothermic: heating shifts left -> lower yield. (c) Catalyst speeds up both forward/reverse equally -> no effect on yield, reaches equilibrium faster

steps.title: Try it yourself
